acceptance_basis: Operator direction on 2026-10-17: in-span energy does not invalidate the testing unless it prevents detecting and validating the pad checks. All pad, identity, persistence, USB and lifecycle checks remain valid; numerical spectral failures are retained as nonblocking observations.

setup.path: GP2/GND per Pico -> individual 20 dB attenuator -> combiner -> 40 dB attenuation -> RSP1B; no antenna or LPF

observation.method: Hann integrate/decimate then per-interval linear unwrapped phase fit
limitations: Receiver clock and frequency axis are uncalibrated.
Decimator is diagnostic; adjacent interference can bias phase.
No absolute GPIO timing or out-of-band harmonic claim.

in_band_spectrum.limitation: Windowed peak-bin ratio in retained receiver band, excluding +/-5 Hz around source/reference; not harmonic or power qualification

baseline-A-137600.subtraction: Mean linear on power minus mean linear quiet power, identical Hann/FFT bins

audit: All original capture/metadata hashes, framing CRCs, independent ARM cardinality, exact images/boards/boots, pad observations, physical enumeration changes and all three original-flash restorations verified.
limitations: Relative conducted amplitude, same receiver settings and path; no calibrated watts.
Two frequencies on A and one on B; no all-band/mode or out-of-span harmonic qualification.
Nominal receiver sample/frequency axis; no calibrated absolute timing/frequency.
New-feature screen excludes 100 Hz around carrier/tuner DC and receiver span beyond 90 kHz.
